##### Project general facts

Avant Garde Residences by Skyline is a beautifully conceived residential tower where thoughtful contemporary architecture meets genuine everyday comfort. Its subtle staggered curves are a graceful nod to the rolling dunes of the Arabian desert and the ebb and flow of the Arabian gulf, while the building's orientation has been strategically positioned to maximise views and deliver bright, practical spaces in every apartment. Created by an award-winning developer with 35 years of experience, an unrivalled record of completing projects on time and more than 150 successful developments behind it, this is a residence built to be enjoyed and treasured for the long term.

Life here revolves around a spectacular 20-metre infinity swimming pool with sunken poolside seating and a baja shelf, joined by a children's pool, a children's splash park and a wonderfully atmospheric silent rooftop cinema. Residents also enjoy a fully equipped gym and a separate outdoor gym, a multipurpose hall and gameroom, indoor and outdoor children's play areas, a rooftop garden, beautifully landscaped gardens and a dedicated BBQ area for gatherings with friends and neighbours. Everyday convenience is equally well considered, with a grand double-height entrance lobby, a resident's lounge, a fully equipped communal workspace, retail shops, locker rooms, four high-speed lifts, electric vehicle and bicycle parking, and a welcoming car drop-off area.

Inside, European interior design with a focus on natural materials and soft, harmonious colour palettes creates a tranquil and elegant ambiance throughout every home. Fully integrated kitchens, integrated bathrooms with generous built-in storage, floor-to-ceiling windows and pragmatically designed balconies make each apartment feel bright, airy and effortlessly liveable, with attentive use of space delivering real efficiency and comfort. World-class materials, fixtures and fittings sourced from reputable global suppliers ensure uncompromised quality and long-term durability that residents will appreciate every single day.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike. This idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood is designed to offer a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Residents of JVC enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It's a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.
